name: Future Communications Company
note: Independently confirmed Kuwait City HQ (est. 1997), 15 physical electronics retail outlets, and a live transactional Shopify storefront in KWD (500+ add-to-cart, checkout present); the substantial dedicated retail arm coexisting with B2B IT-distribution matches the accepted Lazurde/Union Trading hybrid pattern. Electronics is an approved category.

name: Muntazah Holding
note: The holding's own site states it is 'diversified into manufacturing, chain of supermarkets, distribution, and restaurants' (spice manufacturing + water distribution are hard-excluded), triggering Gate 6 parent-exclusion; the qualifying grocery arm (Muntazah Markets, muntazah.com) should carry its own row, and the cited 50k+ app is the loyalty-card app, not a confirmed shopping-app rescue.

name: Matjar Panda
note: Live Riyadh-based Zid store transacting in SAR with a very large multi-category pet catalog (product sitemap lists 3,000+ URLs), clearing Gate 5a independently without needing the app rescue; pet supplies is an approved general-merchandise category.

name: Petite Store
note: petite.sa resolves to a live Shopify store (petite-store.com) with 250+ products in products.json, heavy SAR pricing, Riyadh same-day delivery, confirming a substantial Saudi multi-category pet retailer; approved category and scale both pass.

name: nukhbatech
note: Independent catalog read shows an overwhelmingly security/surveillance product line (CCTV, DVR/NVR, access control, intercoms, alarms, dash cams) with no evidence of the claimed 'smart home/networking' breadth; this is a narrow, low-repeat-purchase, installation/B2B-leaning security-systems specialist (Gate 3 fail pattern) with only ~19-40 SKUs, not broad consumer electronics retail.

name: cascadesco
note: cascadesco.com is 'Cascades KSA', the Saudi branch (SAR pricing, Riyadh) of a Kuwait-origin home-decor brand, yet the row is tagged Kuwait while the actual Kuwait operating entity sits on a different domain (cascadeskw.com); as tagged it fails Gate 1/dedup coherence and must be re-pointed to the genuine Kuwait entity before it can be a clean Yes.

name: twinkle
note: Live Riyadh Shopify store (SAR, Riyadh signals) with 250 products in products.json of party supplies/balloons/tableware/decor, which is consumer general-merchandise product retail (not an event service) with genuine recurring-occasion repeat purchase; scale and geography confirmed.

name: Ghaya Pharmacies Limited
note: Independently confirmed as a 100+ branch retail pharmacy chain across six Saudi cities (HQ Mecca) running a live Salla transactional store (ghayaonline.com, SAR); retail pharmacy chains are the explicit approved-category exception and scale is unambiguous.

name: Ghasham International RP Tech
note: Doha/Qatar HQ (est. 1997) with RP Tech running 52 retail electronics branches plus a live transactional Shopify store (rptech.qa, QAR, 250 products); the substantial dedicated electronics retail arm passes on its own merits alongside the Samsung-distribution/other lines, matching the accepted Al Andalus/Union Trading hybrid pattern.

name: 2d2c2m
note: Live Saudi Shopify streetwear/apparel store transacting in SAR with 59 products in products.json, independently clearing the ~50-SKU floor; apparel is an approved multi-item category. Scale is near the floor and geography is inferred from SAR/Arabic, but it clears every objective gate with no foreign-parent signal.

name: aamaad
note: Independent product-sitemap recount shows only 19 SKUs, all planners/notebooks/refill papers, far below the ~50-SKU floor; the prior '167 product-card elements / substantial catalog' claim was inflated DOM counting, and this thin single-line planner shop fails Gate 5a scale.

name: bymaha
note: Live Saudi Zid store (SAR, Saudi signals, working cart) whose product sitemap independently confirms 69 SKUs, above the floor; modest-fashion apparel is an approved multi-item category.

name: Maraya
note: Maraya self-identifies as the 'first platform dedicated to Arab fashion' curating multiple designer brands (Gate 2 marketplace/aggregator exclusion), the storefront could not be independently loaded via any method to confirm a first-party retail model or checkout, and the Gate 5b 50k+ app-install rescue could not be re-confirmed; genuine unresolved ambiguity keeps it off a clean Yes.

name: NESK Group of Trading Projects
note: Independently confirmed Riyadh HQ and 120+ KSA fashion retail stores as a franchise operator (Mango, Stradivarius, Cortefiel, Polo, Stera, etc.), the exact Saudi-HQ'd franchise-operator pattern Gate 1 explicitly endorses (Cenomi-type); real scale and approved category, and the dead corporate domain does not negate the operating retail footprint.
